# Brand marks

Volkswagen, Audi, Škoda and SEAT SVG marks retrieved from https://cdn.simpleicons.org (black variant). CUPRA retrieved from the official Cyprus website at https://www.cupraofficial.com.cy/etc.clientlibs/cupra-website/components/clientlibs/resources/cupra-diagonal/icons/logo-cupra.svg .
